summary: In this excerpt from a fiction book, the narrator and a companion named Tresting enter a corporate office suite where a massacre has occurred. They find employees slaughtered at their desks and around a conference table, with the victims bound, gagged, and mutilated in various ways. Tresting calls in the scene, and the narrator searches the cubicles and filing cabinets, finding every file folder emptied, suggesting someone removed the paper trail.
one_line: Narrator and Tresting discover a gruesome office massacre and find the filing cabinets emptied of records.
key_facts: The narrator and Tresting enter an office suite after stepping carefully around soaked carpeting, with weapons drawn.
A young, sandy-haired man at a computer had been disemboweled.
The women in the next two cubicles looked like they had tried to run, and one had her head twisted all the way around.
The men and women around the conference table were older, well-dressed corporate types.
All but one of the conference table victims were tied to their chairs with cloth gags choking their corpses.
The one untied victim, a middle-aged man, had a .22-inch diameter hole in his forehead.
Tresting handed the narrator a pair of latex gloves and plastic bags to cover boots, citing forensics as the reason.
Tresting used a Bluetooth earpiece to call someone and described the scene while pulling wallets from the victims to read their IDs.
One woman had been partially flayed.
The narrator says she is not squeamish but closed her eyes briefly at the conference room scene.
The narrator could not deduce anything useful from the blood spatter patterns.
In the outer offices, the narrator dragged open desk drawers and filing cabinets.
Every hanging file folder in the cabinets was empty, and even the paper tabs labeling the folders had been pulled.

entities.name: Tresting
entities.role: companion of the narrator who draws a weapon, hands out gloves and plastic bags, calls in the scene, and reads victims' IDs from their wallets

entities.name: the narrator
entities.role: first-person viewpoint character who examines the massacre scene and searches the cubicles and filing cabinets
